Write the whole-module specification

InputClean RTL module: origen_214034.v
InstructionDescribe the whole module’s interface and observable behavior in self-contained prose.

Read input: origen_214034.v · Open raw
module origen_214034(
    input  wire [5:0] i_instrCode,
    output reg  o_regDst,
    output reg  o_jump,
    output reg  o_branch,
    output reg  o_memToReg,
    output reg [1:0] o_aluOp,
    output reg  o_memWrite,
    output reg  o_aluSrc,
    output reg  o_regWrite,
    output reg  o_aluConI
);

    always @(*) begin
        case (i_instrCode)
            6'h00: begin // R-type
                o_regDst = 1'b1;
                o_jump = 1'b0;
                o_branch = 1'b0;
                o_memToReg = 1'b0;
                o_aluOp = 2'b10;
                o_memWrite = 1'b0;
                o_aluSrc = 1'b0;
                o_regWrite = 1'b1;
                o_aluConI = 1'b0;
            end
            6'h08, 6'h0C: begin // I-type (addi, andi)
                o_regDst = 1'b0;
                o_jump = 1'b0;
                o_branch = 1'b0;
                o_memToReg = 1'b0;
                o_aluOp = 2'b00;
                o_memWrite = 1'b0;
                o_aluSrc = 1'b1;
                o_regWrite = 1'b1;
                o_aluConI = 1'b1;
            end
            6'h23: begin // Load (lw)
                o_regDst = 1'b0;
                o_jump = 1'b0;
                o_branch = 1'b0;
                o_memToReg = 1'b1;
                o_aluOp = 2'b00;
                o_memWrite = 1'b0;
                o_aluSrc = 1'b1;
                o_regWrite = 1'b1;
                o_aluConI = 1'b1;
            end
            6'h2B: begin // Store (sw)
                o_regDst = 1'bx;
                o_jump = 1'b0;
                o_branch = 1'b0;
                o_memToReg = 1'bx;
                o_aluOp = 2'b00;
                o_memWrite = 1'b1;
                o_aluSrc = 1'b1;
                o_regWrite = 1'b0;
                o_aluConI = 1'b1;
            end
            6'h04: begin // Branch (beq)
                o_regDst = 1'bx;
                o_jump = 1'b0;
                o_branch = 1'b1;
                o_memToReg = 1'bx;
                o_aluOp = 2'b01;
                o_memWrite = 1'b0;
                o_aluSrc = 1'b0;
                o_regWrite = 1'b0;
                o_aluConI = 1'b0;
            end
            6'h02: begin // Jump (j)
                o_regDst = 1'bx;
                o_jump = 1'b1;
                o_branch = 1'b0;
                o_memToReg = 1'bx;
                o_aluOp = 2'bxx;
                o_memWrite = 1'b0;
                o_aluSrc = 1'bx;
                o_regWrite = 1'b0;
                o_aluConI = 1'bx;
            end
            default: begin
                o_regDst = 1'bx;
                o_jump = 1'b0;
                o_branch = 1'b0;
                o_memToReg = 1'bx;
                o_aluOp = 2'bxx;
                o_memWrite = 1'b0;
                o_aluSrc = 1'bx;
                o_regWrite = 1'b0;
                o_aluConI = 1'bx;
            end
        endcase
    end

endmodule

Runner-assembled entry point. This package does not retain an exact starting instruction file. The input/output and stage panels below describe the task; the evaluation runner’s saved prompt and visible-file manifest identify the actual entry point. A case manifest or private reference file is not an agent starting instruction.

A stored instruction is distinct from the runtime launch message, which can add framing and execution limits. The agent uses the harness’s file-reading tools to inspect available inputs. The file list also includes human-review reference and oracle assets that must not be given to the evaluated agent.
